title: Conformal anomaly in a vector field model with auxiliary scalar field
authors: Públio Rwany B. R. do Vale
summary: The conformal anomaly has well-known ambiguities related to the possible schemes of regularization and renormalization. In case of dimensional regularization, one of the options is to formulate the theory as conformal in the dimension $D \neq 4$. For a gauge vector field this can be done in several ways and one of the options is to introduce an auxiliary scalar playing the role of a compensator. The advantage of this approach is that it preserves gauge symmetry and avoids problems with possible violation of unitarity.
